label: Model and effort did carry on the live Pi hop: the receiver session header records model_change to llmgateway deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 and thinking_level_change to max, matching the sender, so the Pi 4/5 is not a carry failure.

The scorecard's unobservable carry is a measurement gap: it reads model, effort, name and provider from the receiver argv and marks everything unobservable when the first launch argv is a bare runtime name, which Pi always is, and it never reads the receiver session header.

After a hop nothing durable records the relaunch values: relaunch.log carries only loop id and reason, and the relaunch record is consumed and removed, so a silent drop and a carried value look identical in the artifacts a hop leaves behind.

OpenCode 2 carries neither model nor effort by design: the wrapper appends -m only when the runtime is not OpenCode 2 and the effort appender has branches for Claude, Codex and Pi only, so a receiver starts on the configured default and the 5/5 run matched only because the default was the same model.

Pi spends the nudge level before the nudge is delivered: message_end stores the text in an in-memory map and writes the level, delivery happens later on turn_end or agent_end, so a host reload or a run ending in between loses the text with the level already spent and the session is never nudged at that level again.

The two Pi nudge hooks cannot double-deliver because the held text is deleted from the map before sendMessage, so turn_end and agent_end race but only one delivers; the uncovered Pi risk is loss, not repetition.

OpenCode computes the nudge in its event hook and delivers it in experimental.chat.system.transform, guarded by pendingNudge and handoffPending; a session that claimed a note keeps claimedReminder every request and can simultaneously receive a fresh hand-over nudge once its own fill crosses the threshold, so one system prompt carries two instructions.

direction: Pi dropped the model or effort on relaunch
reason: The receiver session header shows model_change and thinking_level_change to the sender values.

direction: The two Pi nudge hooks can both deliver the same text
reason: deliverHeldNudge deletes the map entry before sendMessage.

direction: OpenCode 2's missing model flag is a replay-builder bug
reason: The version gate is deliberate: a replayed -m would end the OpenCode 2 launch with a usage error.
